posts.name: Ironic
posts.cooked:
Eh.

Wraith's archrival is a vapid burglar who is actually a vapid socialite who is Maia's archrival.  Maia spent her time in school being infamous for focus and multitasking, while she was actually training to be Wraith through focus and multitasking.  I just don't see a huge disconnect here.

I mean, I would ship Bunker with almost any non-creepy option before Wraith.  I don't like pairing heroes with the same power source, and Bunker deserves a much more interesting character to play off of than Wraith.  But even I have to admit, it's hard to see a reason why it couldn't work.

Well, except the obvious: He'd keep on breaking the flow of dates to try and figure out what she's using that hairdryer for.

Ironic
